sections.content:
How to tell direct and indirect objects apart:
• Direct Object (DO): The thing or person directly affected. Question: ¿Qué? (What?) or ¿A quién? (Whom?). Pronouns: lo, la, los, las.
• Indirect Object (IO): The recipient. Question: ¿A quién le...? (To/for whom?). Pronouns: le, les (me, te, nos).

sections.title: Direct vs. Indirect Comparison
rows: Doy el libro a Carlos → Le doy el libro.

items.english: I bought flowers → I bought them.

items.spanish: Compré flores a mi madre (IO) → Le compré flores.
items.english: I bought flowers for my mother → I bought her flowers.

items.spanish: Llamé a Carlos (DO) → Lo llamé. / Escribí a Carlos (IO) → Le escribí.
items.english: I called Carlos → I called him. / I wrote to Carlos → I wrote to him.
